# Power numbers (generated by docs/hardware/power_calc.py)

Status: tested in simulation. 40 walking runs of 20 s on F2 (bhl_F2), case 7, 1 falls.

## Motor bus (24 V, two 6S packs through the diode)

- Battery power, walking, mean of the runs: 34 W (highest run 41 W). Standing: 21 W. Both include 18 W drive standby (ASSUMED).
- Peak bus power: 191 W instant, 148 W over 20 ms. Peak into one drive: 107 W.
- Peak regen of the 12 drives together: 54 W. Peak regen of one drive: 79 W (3.3 A at 24 V). Mean regen power: at most 1.4 W in one run.
- Pump (KLP02, through the DMC-101, after relay K1): 12 W or less while it sprays (0.5 A at 24 V, datasheet). At 10 % spray time (ASSUMED): 1.2 W on average.
- Battery time, two 6S at 80 % usable, simulated walking power plus the mean pump power: 5.0 h.
